identification: Three large postcard/photo albums plus loose cards: mostly modern colour (chrome) postcards of Europe from roughly the 1960s-80s (Vienna interiors and churches, Rhine castles and river maps, London, a ski scene), some small holiday snaps and a map sheet mounted in the albums, a few loose cards (one black and white lion). No old (pre-1940) cards visible.

entries.note: Album of postcards around the world, excellent condition, this seller's listings were single album pages, small count.
Rare 1900s bound mini postcard album, South Australia, much older material than this lot.

searches_tried: | chrome: Terapeak AU: 'postcard album vintage postcards' (50 rows). Google x1.
viewing_check: Estimate $30-40, current bid $15. Flip through each album for pre-1950 cards, real photo cards, Australian or Tasmanian views and stamps/postmarks; those are the only cards with real value. Modern Europe chrome cards sell for a few dollars per small lot. Prices 2024-2026, flat.
